input.prompt: Photoreal cinematic close-up inside an old Lebanese stone mill: a pair of round, flat millstones lying HORIZONTALLY, one on top of the other, like two thick stone discs; the upper runner stone turns flat around a vertical axis. It is NOT an upright wheel. Whole-wheat kernels trickle from a wooden hopper into the round hole in the centre of the upper stone, and fine light-brown whole-wheat flour with bran specks spills out from the narrow gap between the two stones onto the stone platform and into a wooden trough. Warm window light, flour dust in the air, limestone walls, 35mm film look. No text. Ultra-photoreal cinematic film still, Lebanese mountain heritage, warm golden-hour light, shallow depth of field, natural film grain, 35mm anamorphic look, restrained colour grade with limestone, wheat-gold and deep green tones. No text, no logos, no watermarks.
